test.name: Spec 0010 spike: PROC_PIDTBSDINFO facts for this user's processes

expected: proc_pidinfo(PROC_PIDTBSDINFO) gives pid, ppid, pgid, uid, status and the start time in seconds and microseconds for this user's processes, child or not, suspended or running, and fails for gone or zombie pids (spec 0010 AC-2, AC-9, Adapter macOS row Waktu start, user, group, parent, tertahan)
actual: Suspended child: pid, ppid = spike, pgid = pid (SETSID), uid 502, start time in seconds and microseconds (for example 1792315326.054120, 0.4 s before now), unchanged after SIGCONT. Non-child (its daemon exited, ppid 1, another session): readable, start time equals the one the old daemon recorded while the child was suspended, uid matches, pgid = pid. Zombie child (exited, not reaped): PROC_PIDTBSDINFO returns ESRCH, so inspect returns None as the spec wants, while kinfo p_stat shows SZOMB and kill(pid, 0) still succeeds (the pid stays taken until reaped). Absent pid: ESRCH. struct proc_bsdinfo in libc 0.2.190 is 136 bytes, equal to the SDK. kinfo_proc start time and uid equal PROC_PIDTBSDINFO for our own process. Other users' processes are a separate record (PROC_PIDTBSDINFO on other users' processes).
